description: First jaw contact angle (deg of opening from the closed jaw) over the neck and head pose grid; null = clear to clear_to_deg. Read by jaw_limits.py and the simulator jaw-safety.js.
method: guide/extension-20261012-neck-audio/jaw-neck-check/scripts/pose_cap_sweep.py (CAD contact sweep, 0.2 mm contact on meshes simplified to 0.05 mm with a 0.3 mm threshold, bisected to 0.25 deg) combined by build_pose_caps.py: min over the bracket, neck and torso part groups (torso nodes scanned up to the bracket/neck contact for the head pose, which leaves the minimum unchanged).
